disposition_reason: A review that only quotes chicken-tissue metal data from four earlier Pakistani studies; no new measurements.

study.design: narrative review comparing four earlier Pakistani studies of chicken tissues
study.origin: Karachi, Kohat, Lahore and Kasur, Pakistan (as reported by the cited studies)

unresolved: Tables 1-4 reproduce lead, cadmium, zinc, copper and nickel means in chicken liver, meat, heart, kidney and blood from four cited studies: Khan et al. (Karachi, ref 19), Ei-Salam et al. (Kohat, ref 20), Mariam et al. 2004 (Lahore, ref 21) and Imran et al. (Kasur); values are quotes and are not recorded as findings.
The cited primary studies should be ingested directly if needed.
